acts: AIFC Rules No. FR0007 of 2017 (Fees Rules)

en.title: FEES 3.1.2 and 3.1.4(b): the initial supervision fee runs from "the grant of the Licence", which recognised Non-AIFC bodies never receive
en.summary: Before Amendments No. 17 the due date ran from "the commencement of operations", which fitted every payer. Since then the initial annual supervision fee is due "within 21 days of the date of the grant of the Licence" and is pro-rated from that date. FEES 3.1.1 also makes Recognised Non-AIFC Market Institutions and Members pay the fee, but they are recognised by an order under the Framework Regulations, not licensed under Part 3, so the specific due date and the pro-rating do not fit them.
en.correction: For recognised Non-AIFC institutions and members, please name the effective date of recognition as the trigger for the initial supervision fee and its pro-rating.

quotes.source: AIFC Fees Rules (FEES), V18, with amendments as of 13 November 2025
quotes.text: Recognised NonAIFC Market Institution or Recognised Non-AIFC Member must pay to the AFSA:

quotes.source: AIFC Fees Rules (FEES), V18, with amendments as of 13 November 2025
quotes.text: The initial annual supervision fee must be paid in full to the AFSA within 21 days of the date of the grant of the Licence.

quotes.source: AIFC Fees Rules (FEES), V18, with amendments as of 13 November 2025
quotes.text: over the whole months remaining between the date of the grant of the Licence and the end of the year.
